gloss: to show off; to flaunt; to display proudly

definitions.explanation: To display something conspicuously to impress others, often with a sense of boasting.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{車|くるま}を{見|み}せびらかしている。
examples.english: He's showing off his new car.

examples.japanese: SNSで{高級|こうきゅう}{ブランド|ぶらんど}を{見|み}せびらかすのは{品|ひん}がない。
examples.english: It's tacky to show off luxury brands on social media.

examples.japanese: {知識|ちしき}を{見|み}せびらかすのは{嫌|きら}われる。
examples.english: Flaunting your knowledge makes people dislike you.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{新|あたら}しいおもちゃを{友達|ともだち}に{見|み}せびらかしていた。
examples.english: The child was showing off the new toy to friends.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}の{写真|しゃしん}をみんなに{見|み}せびらかして{自慢|じまん}していた。
examples.english: He was showing off his overseas travel photos to everyone and bragging.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{見|み}せびらかす → {見|み}せびらかさない (negative)
・{見|み}せびらかす → {見|み}せびらかして (te-form)
・{見|み}せびらかす → {見|み}せびらかした (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {見|み}せる (to show) + びらかす (to spread out/display)

REGISTER:
Slightly negative connotation. Implies vanity or boastfulness. Used critically to describe someone's behavior.

USAGE:
・{財産|ざいさん}を{見|み}せびらかす (to flaunt wealth)
・{成功|せいこう}を{見|み}せびらかす (to show off success)
・{能力|のうりょく}を{見|み}せびらかす (to show off one's abilities)
